'''Griwstrick''' was an unaligned terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] featuring patches of [[Bamboo/Legends|bamboos]].<ref name="TUR" /> It was situated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Griwstrick system/Legends|Griwstrick system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and constituted a part of the [[Rakatan Archipelago]], a fragmented group of planets [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by tribes of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after the collapse of the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]<ref name="TUR" /> around [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The Rakatan tribe that settled Griwstrick also brought guard animals there, including offshoots of the [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|sand panther]],<ref name="TUR" /> a large [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Diet/Legends|predator]] native to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> Due to [[Reproduction/Legends|overbreeding]] among the Griwstrick sand panther variant, however, the offshoots were [[Mutant|mutated]] and no larger in size than [[Scurrier/Legends|scurriers]],<ref name="TUR" /> small creatures from<ref name="DB">{{DB|creature|scurrier|scurrier}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The sand panthers on Griwstrick inhabited the planet's bamboo-covered areas.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Griwstrick was introduced in the [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
